asset.name: ArrayField
asset.description: The repeating-field controller for ordered arrays with add, remove, duplicate, reorder, length constraints, nested validation, and optional virtualization for large collections.

requires.reason: Values, validation, dirtiness, and submission live in the field-granular store rather than component state.
Each item composes the shared field relationships.

suggests.reason: Drag reordering is valuable for user-ordered arrays and unnecessary for append-only ones.
